completion.scope: Actual freeze-button click through complete status, validated result table and two animation frames; includes Worker startup, record validation and SVG DOM rendering.

synchronousMessageHandler.scope: Synchronous time inside the assigned Worker onmessage handler only; excludes every continuation after await. This is not complete main-thread task duration.

cancellation.scope: Actual cancel-button click to MutationObserver seeing cancelled status; storage completion is excluded.

progress.scope: Visible progress status commits, rather than claimed Worker emission timestamps; 25 ms render scheduling allowance.

longTasks.scope: Chromium PerformanceObserver longtask diagnostics for the page; not an upper bound on total work or a substitute for full completion timing.
